d: Somewhere in the wild, could animals thought lost forever still be surviving beyond human reach? Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante sets out to investigate some of the planet’s most puzzling extinction mysteries. From the elusive Formosan Clouded Leopard and the legendary Great Auk to the Ivory-billed Woodpecker and the mysterious White Wolf of Newfoundland, each search follows clues that could challenge what we know about these missing species.
